lines.text: Your issues are monsters!
lines.el: [shouts] Your issues are MONSTERS!

lines.text: Your AI agents are units!
lines.el: [excited] Your AI agents are UNITS!

lines.text: GBrain is their shared memory!
lines.el: [excited] G Brain is their shared memory!
lines.say: G Brain is their shared memory!

lines.text: River forges new unit types!
lines.el: [excited] River forges NEW unit types!

lines.text: This is QM RAID!
lines.el: [shouts] This is Q M RAID!

lines.text: Hear ye! Order a knight, a real QM agent, to a camp.
lines.el: Hear ye! Order a knight, a real Q M agent, to a camp.
lines.say: Hear ye! Order a knight, a real Q M agent, to a camp.

lines.text: Blue beam: it recalls from GBrain.
lines.el: Blue beam: it recalls from G Brain.
lines.say: Blue beam: it recalls from G Brain.

lines.text: Gold orb: it remembers what it learned.
lines.el: Gold orb: it remembers what it learned.

lines.text: Three units, one team: the Trio.
lines.el: Three units, one team: the Trio.

lines.text: The reviewer checks the house rules.
lines.el: The reviewer checks the house rules...

lines.text: The reviewer is a Rule Warden, forged by River.
lines.el: The reviewer is a Rule Warden, forged by River.

lines.text: Verdict: approved!
lines.el: [excited] Verdict: APPROVED!

lines.text: Verdict: changes! Back to work.
lines.el: Verdict: changes! Back to work.

lines.text: At the Forge, River fine-tunes new unit types.
lines.el: At the Forge... River fine-tunes new unit types.

lines.text: Refund Ranger, Rule Warden: each beats its base model on held-out test orders.
lines.el: Refund Ranger, Rule Warden: each beats its base model on held-out test orders.

lines.text: Train one, and out it walks!
lines.el: Train one, and out it walks!

lines.text: A new issue? A fresh camp appears.
lines.el: A new issue? A fresh camp appears.

lines.text: Autopilot proposes orders, with a fifteen second veto.
lines.el: Autopilot proposes orders... with a fifteen second veto.

lines.text: And a knight's standing orders? Rewrite them in the game.
lines.el: And a knight's standing orders? [mischievously] Rewrite them in the game.

lines.text: One human. Thirty-one AI agents. Built today.
lines.el: One human. Thirty-one AI agents. Built today.

lines.text: One human, a swarm of AI agents, built today.
lines.el: One human, a swarm of AI agents, built today.
